reproducedAssociation: Identical actual current Native data and inventory can have a different complete predecessor. A latest-observed predecessor is not necessarily the retained catalogue predecessor.
observedRefusal: The unchanged genuine-host admission rejects the wrong predecessor with inventory_source.
observedRepair: A new real host.refreshAfter(originalObservedCut) control is admitted with the same current data, inventory and immutable catalogue.
scope: Genuine Native controls and inventory; immutable closed catalogue server-boundary DATA with empty participant rows. No recovered actor or serving grant is supplied by that DATA. The broader warm/cold joint workflow remains isolated and unqualified.
